message.content: {"caption":"Architecture diagram of a two-stage agent that plans from stored cases and executes subtasks using external tools.","description":"A left-to-right system diagram divided into two colored stages. In the teal Stage 1, Case-Based Planning, an LLM planner receives a user query and a decomposed plan, reads prior cases from a case bank through Case Memory, and exchanges subtasks and results with Subtask Memory. Arrows show planning, replanning, and writing completed cases back to memory; the planner produces an answer. In the yellow Stage 2, Tool-Based Execution, an LLM executor uses Tool Memory and connects through an MCP server and protocol to registered tools. The available tool categories are Search, Crawl, Video, Image, Code, Math, and Doc. Arrows indicate tool requests, results, and coordination between the planner and executor.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
